item.title: BI-Agent and BI-Bench: Towards Automating End-to-End Business Intelligence
item.description:
The paper tackles the tedious manual steps of building BI reports by training a large language model to auto‑identify tables, transform data and answer queries end‑to‑end, creating the BI‑Agent tool and a benchmark (BI‑Bench). It shows that the model can generate correct answers with minimal user input, dramatically cutting BI prep time.

IT Breakdown: If you manage BI workflows, set up an LLM‑based assistant to auto‑generate queries and data models: 1) feed your data catalogue to the model, 2) prompt it with the business question, 3) review and publish the returned data model and visualisation.

item.title: [News] New Microsoft data innovations unlock what only your business knows
item.description: Microsoft has announced new data‑centric AI innovations designed to harness proprietary business data within its ecosystem, emphasizing enhanced contextual understanding for enterprise applications. These updates are positioned to integrate with Azure and Microsoft 365, offering deeper analytics and smarter decision support for businesses.

item.title: [News] Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics
item.description: Google DeepMind has unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, a new AI model tailored for robotics applications. This release extends the Gemini family, offering enhanced perception, control, and reasoning capabilities for robotic systems.

item.title: [News] Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
item.description: Google DeepMind has unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, a next‑generation language model that promises improved reasoning, multimodal capabilities, and more efficient fine‑tuning. The model is positioned to power advanced AI applications across Google’s ecosystem, potentially impacting tools from Workspace to cloud infrastructure.

item.title: [News] The Download: open model trade-offs and geothermal power’s promise
item.description: Anthropic’s recent report highlights a powerful new model from Chinese firm Z.ai that could pose significant cyber‑attack risks. The analysis underscores the trade‑offs of open models in the context of national security and cyber defense.

item.title: [News] SpaceXSI bundles X Premium, Grok, and Cursor into one subscription
item.description: SpaceXSI has introduced a new X Subscription that bundles its X Premium features with AI tools Grok and Cursor under a single subscription model, with tiers ranging from $8 to $200 per month.
